product_metadata.title: Willow Tree Crèche, hand-painted nativity backdrop
features: Created for the Willow Tree Nativity collection

17”h x 20”w x 11.5”d. Constructed of wood and painted by hand. Three-piece assembly; folds flat for storage. . Created for the Nativity collection Ready to display on a shelf, table or mantel. To clean, dust with soft brush or cloth.

The Crèche is part of the Nativity collection. As enduring as the story it portrays, the Willow Tree Nativity is as loved today as when it was originally introduced in 2000. Its simplicity and form has made it a timeless classic. As a Christmas gift, wedding gift or self-purchase, the Willow Tree Nativity continues on as a family tradition. Packaged in fitted box ready for gift-giving.
Crèche is designed by artist Susan Lordi from her studio in Kansas City MO. This piece is constructed from Susan's original prototype and painted by hand.

The Willow Tree Nativity collection is a favorite holiday tradition...the simplicity and elegant form of the figures and animals have made it a timeless classic. As enduring as the story it portrays, the Willow Tree Nativity is as loved today as when it was originally introduced in 2000.
description: TITLE: Crèche for the Nativity DESCRIPTION: The Crèche is part of the Nativity collection. As enduring as the story it portrays, the Willow Tree Nativity is as loved today as when it was originally introduced in 2000. Its simplicity and form has made it a timeless classic. As a Christmas gift, wedding gift or self-purchase, the Willow Tree Nativity continues on as a family tradition. Since 1999, American artist Susan Lordi has worked in partnership with DEMDACO to produce, market and distribute Willow Tree , her line of carved figurative sculpture. From her studio in Kansas City, Lordi hand carves the original of each figure, and designs accompanying pieces. This piece is constructed from Lordi's original prototype and painted by hand. Enclosed inside the fitted packaging box is a gift-giving card with piece title on it. Ready to display on a shelf, table or mantel. To clean, dust with soft brush or cloth. Avoid water or cleaning solvents.
